title: Reject terminal portfolio work before PIN/claim
problem: Portfolio fallback allocation can waste a worker cycle by checking claim/PIN availability before terminal returns. The live-compounding-metrics lane demonstrated the failure mode: a later attempt found no useful ownership boundary, but a prior DONE return already closed the dedupe key, so the duplicate attempt was recorded SUPERSEDED. Terminality should dominate ownership inspection.
mission: Add a deterministic read-only portfolio preflight that resolves terminal return state for exact job_id and dedupe_key aliases before any PIN or claim attempt, while preserving existing deterministic priority and recovery rules for genuinely open work.
acceptance: For each candidate row, exact job_id and dedupe_key aliases are checked for terminal RETURN evidence before PIN or legacy-claim ownership logic.
A terminal DONE/SUPERSEDED-equivalent closure is rejected without creating a new PIN, claim or recovery generation.
BOUNDARY or other explicitly nonterminal returns do not falsely close the job.
Fixtures cover terminal-without-pin, open-without-pin, nonterminal-return, and duplicate-dedupe aliases.
The result is deterministic across repeated runs against the same repository snapshot.
No Current, Catalog, Human Accepted, Served or production authority is changed.

regression_prevention.reason: Prevents duplicate ownership traffic against already-closed dedupe keys and makes terminal state strictly precede recovery/ownership reasoning.

throughput.reason: Surplus /wc workers stop spending allocation calls on finished jobs and can reach compatible open work or discovery sooner.

collision_reduction.reason: No PIN/claim should be emitted when terminal evidence already closes the job, reducing avoidable ledger noise.

falsification: A job with a terminal return still reaches PIN or claim creation.
A nonterminal BOUNDARY return is incorrectly treated as terminal.
Two job IDs sharing one dedupe key can both be selected after one dedupe-equivalent lane is terminal.
The preflight changes authority pointers or production state.
